page_title: SEV 1-0 BET | Sevilla v Betis 06/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 91' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decides to make a substitution. Chidera Ejuke will be replaced by Marcao (Sevilla).
90+8' Juan Martinez Munuera is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) touches the ball with his hand.
90+3' A rebound falls kindly for Giovani Lo Celso (Betis), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
90' 7 additional min. will be played.

90' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle and Tanguy Nianzou (Sevilla) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
88' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Rui Silva was alert and made a comfortable save.
86' Ricardo Rodriguez will be replaced by Romain Perraud (Betis).
84' Having seen unsporting behavior, Juan Martinez Munuera shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) is the recipient.
83' Chimy Avila (Betis) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
82' Close! Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
82' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
81' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Martinez Munuera had an easy-decision to make.
81' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post.
79' Chimy Avila (Betis) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Abde Ezzalzouli.
79' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Adria Pedrosa and he is replaced by Kike Salas (Sevilla).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Peque departs the field of play to be replaced by Suso (Sevilla).
78' Orjan Nyland (Sevilla) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
76' Yellow card. Tanguy Nianzou (Sevilla) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
74' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
72' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jesus Navas (Sevilla) replacing Isaac Romero.
72' Lucien Agoume goes off the pitch and Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) comes on.
71' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
69' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) passes the ball onto Peque, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
66' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
64' Here is a change. Marc Roca is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Aitor Ruibal (Betis).
64' Substitution. Cedric Bakambu (Betis) on for Vitor Roque.
64' Dangerous play by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis). Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.

63' Peque (Sevilla) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
58' The game is interrupted now, Pablo Fornals (Betis) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
56' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
55' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
54' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
54' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
52' Natan (Betis) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
50' 1 - 0 Goal! Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) slams home the penalty with a precise shot which goes inside the right post.
50' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
49' Referee Juan Martinez Munuera is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Sevilla!
48' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Sevilla using VAR. Let's see what happens.

47' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Diego Llorente (Betis) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Sevilla are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
46' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
46' The whistle blows and Juan Martinez Munuera starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) was too forceful with his tackle and Juan Martinez Munuera interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
45+2' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
42' Loic Bade (Sevilla) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
41' What a beautiful long-range strike by Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla). He is quite unlucky as his shot flies just over the bar.
40' The resulting free kick from Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.

39' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Juan Martinez Munuera blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
36' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
36' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
35' Vitor Roque (Betis) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Orjan Nyland has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
34' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the left post.
30' Betis failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

29' Vitor Roque (Betis) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Orjan Nyland pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
27' Sevilla fail to score from a corner as Rui Silva (Betis) leaps to collect the ball.
26' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
24' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Rui Silva, who smothers the ball.
22' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Rui Silva was alert and made a comfortable save.
21' What was Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
18' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
17' Orjan Nyland pulls off a fantastic save! Vitor Roque (Betis) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out.
14' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
10' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) has a goal ruled out for offside!
7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla.
1' The match has just started.
Sevilla will kick the game off.
Juan Martinez Munuera was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
